messages:
Alex (PM): AM async — quick standup check for the sprint slice. What I did / blockers / today. TLDR: prioritize launch-blocking items first.
Maya (Eng): Did the v2 routing change and wire up feature flag. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/feat/v2-routing. Ready for review, but blocked on API contract question from Sam.
Sam (Eng Lead): On it — will look in ~2hrs. Heads-up: I want automated contract tests added before approving. Please add a small test harness in `tests/contract/`.
Maya (Eng): Ack. I can add a lightweight harness today. Might need a stub for the external embed service — Priya can you help with mocks?
Priya (QA): I can provide a mock. FYI I found a regression in embed-cache during local replay: tokens dropped when prefix cache misses >1. Test case attached: `embed-cache/regress/301-miss-seq`. Repro steps in the thread.
Maya (Eng): Thanks — I'll triage the cache regression after adding the contract test. If it's deeper, may need Sam to take a look. ETA EOD for initial fixes.
Sam (Eng Lead): If contract tests + harness added, I can fast-track CR this afternoon. Otherwise it'll slip to tomorrow morning.
Jordan (Infra): Reminder — we're doing a minor k8s node upgrade tonight 10pm–11pm PT. Shouldn't affect canary but expect ~1–2 minute pod restarts in the ded pool. If anyone needs strict latency SLO unaffected, please flag.
Alex (PM): Good call. @Jordan please add the maintenance note to Console banner and #eng-oncall. We should avoid pushing heavy migrations during the window.
Jordan (Infra): Will do — posting maintenance now.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for `redwood-routing:v2` started at 2877654350. Monitoring hooks enabled.
Priya (QA): I'll run the contract harness against canary once deploy finishes. If embed-cache regression still appears, I'll open a priority bug with logs.
Maya (Eng): Quick ask — can we delay non-blocking telemetry cleanup to next sprint? It's on my board but not launch-critical.
Alex (PM): Yes — deprioritize telemetry cleanup. Focus scope on routing, contract tests, and embed-cache fix.
Sam (Eng Lead): Also pinging @Maya for one more thing: add a rollback flag in the deploy manifest. If canary shows error rate >1% for 5min, auto-fallback to `redwood-routing:v1`.
Maya (Eng): Will add the flag and smoke test it locally. Pushing a tiny PR after the contract harness.
Priya (QA): After harness CR lands, I'll do a focused smoke and the regression replay. If green, we sign off on canary metrics.
Alex (PM): Perfect. Summary: Maya adds contract test + rollback flag; Priya runs regression and smoke; Sam reviews CR; Jordan posts maintenance + monitors infra; deploy-bot doing canary. If any blocker, call out ASAP in this thread or ping on-call.
Maya (Eng): Understood — I'll post PR link when ready. :rocket:
Sam (Eng Lead): Quick note — if the contract test reveals any API mismatches, please include the failing request/response in the PR to speed review.
Priya (QA): I'll attach example failing traces.
Alex (PM): Thanks team. If no major blockers, aim for canary sign-off by 3pm PT. Otherwise we'll regroup in the afternoon async check.
Maya (Eng): 1:1: expected PR in ~90–120m. Will follow up.
Sam (Eng Lead): Good progress. :thumbsup:
notes: This is an async product-standup style thread focused on launch gating, PR/CR pings, infra maintenance, and a regression triage for embed-cache. Contains short informal Slack-style messages, @mentions, links, and a deploy-bot update.
